DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの物を届けに来られたのでしょうか。どの品ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come to hand in something you are carrying? Which item is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 拾ったのは、この小さいポーチです。運ぶために私の買物袋に入れたので、袋ごと拾ったわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾ったのは小さいポーチだけで、自分の買物袋は運ぶために使ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found this small pouch. I put it in my shopping bag to carry it; I did not find the bag with it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you found only the small pouch and used your own shopping bag to carry it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ポーチを拾った場所と、時刻を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you tell me where and when you found the pouch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 公園の入口に近いベンチの横です。拾った直後に友人へ電話したので、その履歴の時刻を目安に説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口近くのベンチ横で拾い、直後の友人への通話履歴を時刻の目安にできると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Beside a bench near the park entrance. I called a friend immediately afterward, so I can use that call-history time as a guide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you found it beside a bench near the entrance and can use the call to your friend immediately afterward as a time guide. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通話の時刻を目安にした説明ですね。拾った時、ポーチは開いていましたか。中をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the call time is an approximate reference. Was the pouch open when you found it? Did you look inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 閉じていて、私は開けていません。見つけた時は、この買物袋も一緒にはありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発見時にポーチは閉じており開けず、買物袋も一緒にはなかったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was closed and I did not open it. This shopping bag was not with it when I found it either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the pouch was closed when found, you did not open it, and the shopping bag was not there with it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのまま閉じた状態でお持ちになったのですね。袋の中に、ほかの物も入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You brought it still closed, then. Is anything else in the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の買物のレシートが一枚あります。ポーチの外に入っている物で、拾った物の中身ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋には自分のレシート一枚があるがポーチの外で、拾得物の中身ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: One receipt from my shopping. It is outside the pouch, not among the contents of the found item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the bag contains one of your own receipts, outside the pouch, and it is not part of the found item's contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、拾った品と運ぶ時に加わった物を区別して確認します。袋の中の様子も、担当に今の説明をお伝えいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will distinguish the found item from things added for carrying. Could you give the staff member that explanation of the bag's contents too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。ポーチだけを拾い、後から自分の袋に入れたと説明します。レシートは私の物で、時刻は電話の履歴が目安だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ポーチだけを拾い後から自分の袋を使ったこと、レシートの所属と時刻の根拠を担当へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will say I found only the pouch and put it in my own bag afterward. The receipt is mine, and the time is based on my call history.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell staff that you found only the pouch, added your own bag afterward, and explain receipt ownership and the basis for the time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。拾った状況と持参時の状態を合わせて伺います。それでは、こちらで担当と内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will ask about both the finding circumstances and its condition when brought in. Please confirm the details with the staff member here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後の郵便についてですね。以前と現在のお住まいを伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This concerns mail after moving. May I ask your previous and current homes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の寮から自分で借りた部屋へ移りました。寮に来る物を全部新居へ送ってもらう手続きを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社寮から個人で借りた部屋へ移り、寮への郵便を新居へ送る手続きを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I moved from company accommodation to a room I rent myself. I want advice on having everything sent to the accommodation forwarded to my new home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain moving from company accommodation to a privately rented room and ask about forwarding mail from the accommodation to the new home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 旧住所に届く物が、すべてご本人宛てとは限りませんね。相談したい封筒の名宛人も確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Not everything arriving at the old address is necessarily addressed to you. Could we check the addressees on the envelopes you want to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この二枚です。一枚は私の名前ですが、もう一枚は会社の名前だけで、私の名前はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚の封筒を示し、一枚は本人名、もう一枚は本人名のない会社宛てと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: These two. One has my name, but the other only has the company's name, not mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show two envelopes and explain that one names you and the other names only the company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 住所が同じでも、名宛人は別として伺います。会社名の封筒は、会社からどのように扱うよう言われていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even at the same address, we will treat the addressees separately. What has the company told you to do with its envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 何も聞いていませんでした。自分の郵便と一緒に考えず、会社宛ての方は担当者へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社から扱いを聞いておらず、自分の郵便と混ぜず会社担当へ確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not been told anything. I will not group it with my own mail; I will check the company-addressed one with their person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the company has given no instructions and you will check with its contact separately from your own mail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の分の相談と分けましょう。新住所と、寮に住んでいた時の住所が分かる物はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us separate it from your personal inquiry. Do you have something showing the new address and the address where you lived in company accommodation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新居の住所のメモと、寮の住所が載った本人宛ての封筒があります。会社宛ての封筒とは別にお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新住所メモと旧寮住所の本人宛て封筒を、会社宛て封筒と別に提示すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: A note of my new address and an envelope addressed to me showing the old accommodation address. I will show them separately from the company envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will present the new-address note and your own envelope showing the old accommodation address separately from the company's envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報で、ご本人について必要な確認と申込み方法をご案内します。転送できる範囲や反映についても、担当に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: With that information, we will explain the checks and application method needed for you. Let us also ask staff what can be forwarded and how the change takes effect.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の分の対象と手続きを先に聞きます。会社宛てまで私が申し込めるとは考えず、二つを分けたまま相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人分の対象と方法を先に聞き、会社宛ての申込み権限を仮定せず区別して相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first ask what personal mail qualifies and how to apply. I will keep the two separate without assuming I can apply for the company's mail too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask first about your own eligible mail and procedure, keeping it separate without assuming authority to apply for the company's mail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。名宛人を分けて、ご本人の転居のご相談として担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、こちらでご案内をお受けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will distinguish the addressees and hand this over as your personal moving inquiry. Please receive guidance here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録情報についてのご相談ですね。変更なさった項目はどちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about registered details. Which field did you change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯でアドレスを変えましたが、銀行の手紙が前の家へ届いたそうです。住所も変えたことになっていると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: アドレスを携帯で変えたが旧居へ手紙が届き、住所も変わったと思っていたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I changed my address on my phone, but apparently a bank letter arrived at my former home. I thought my residential address had changed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you changed an address on your phone but a letter reached the old home, and you had thought the residential address changed too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メールのアドレスと、お住まいの住所を分けて確認しましょう。操作した画面の項目名は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check email address separately from home address. Do you know the field name on the screen you used?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 画面にはメールアドレスとあります。新しいメールが届くようにしただけで、家の住所は入力していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 変更画面はメールアドレスで、住居の住所は入力していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says email address. I only arranged to receive new emails; I did not enter my home address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the changed field was email address and you did not enter a residential address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、転居した住所の変更は別のご希望として伺います。新しい住所を確認できる物はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we will treat changing your address after moving as a separate request. Do you have a document confirming the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、この書類を持っています。前の家に届いた手紙は、宛先が分かる写真を家族に送ってもらい、担当の方に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新住所の確認書類を持ち、旧居へ届いた手紙の宛先写真を家族から受けて担当に示したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, this document. I want my family to send a photo showing the destination on the letter at the old home, so staff can see it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have new-address documentation and want a photo from family showing the old-home letter's destination to show staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類をお手元にご用意ください。ご本人の登録の確認は担当が行います。手紙が届いた時期もお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please have the document ready. Staff will check your registration. Do you also know when the letter arrived?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族から昨日届いたと聞きました。メールを変えたのは先週ですが、それだけで郵便先も変わったとは言えないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メール変更は先週、旧居の配達は昨日と伝え、それだけで郵便先変更とは判断できないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family said yesterday. I changed email last week, but that alone does not mean the postal destination changed, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say email changed last week and delivery to the old home was yesterday, confirming that this alone does not establish a postal-address change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つの項目を分けて確認しましょう。住所変更を相談する際、今後の通知先や反映時期も併せてお尋ねになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the two fields separately. When discussing the address change, would you also ask about future notification destinations and when it takes effect?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。新住所の変更と、通知先がいつどう扱われるかを聞きたいです。メールの変更とは別の相談としてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メールとは別に新住所の変更と今後の通知先・反映時期を相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I want to ask about changing to the new address and how and when notification destinations will be handled. Please treat this separately from the email change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request a separate inquiry from email about the new residential address, future notification destination and effective timing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。変更したのはメールで、住所と通知先はこれから確認するご希望として引き継ぎます。それでは、担当へ書類をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will hand over that email was changed, while address and notification destination remain requests to check. Please show staff your document.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 飲み物の表示で、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the drink label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この大きい果汁飲料を職場で少しずつ飲みたいです。常温で保存とあるので、開けてからも机に置けると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きい果汁飲料を職場で数日に分け、常温表示から開封後も机で保存できると思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to drink this large juice drink gradually at work. It says store at room temperature, so I thought I could leave it on my desk after opening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you planned to drink the large juice drink at work over several days and thought the room-temperature label allowed desk storage after opening. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その欄は未開封の場合と書かれています。開封後の案内は、こちらの別の欄にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: That section says it applies unopened. The instructions after opening are in this other section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つの条件を一緒に読んでいました。開封後は冷蔵という欄ですね。職場には使える冷蔵庫がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封と開封後を混同したと認め、開封後冷蔵だが職場に使える冷蔵庫がないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was reading the two conditions together. This says refrigerate after opening. There is no refrigerator I can use at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge confusing unopened and opened conditions and say refrigeration is required after opening but no usable work refrigerator is available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 職場で何日にも分ける予定とは、条件が合うか考え直す必要がありますね。容量の小さい品も比べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to reconsider whether that suits drinking it over several days at work. Would you compare smaller sizes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。一度に飲み切れる量の物を見たいです。大きい方を少しずつ使う前提はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大瓶を少しずつ使う案をやめ、一度で飲み切る量の小容量を比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I want to see an amount I can finish at once. I will drop the plan of using the large one little by little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will abandon using the large bottle gradually and compare smaller quantities you can finish in one sitting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに小さい容量の品があります。ただし、保存表示はその品で改めてお確かめください。何本を予定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are smaller products here. But check the storage instructions again on that particular product. How many bottles are you considering?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず一本にします。何日分も一緒に買わず、この品の原材料と、開封前後の保存の欄を読んで選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小さい品をまず一本とし、原材料と開封前後の保存表示をその品で読んで選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: One to begin with. Rather than buying several days' worth together, I want to read this product's ingredients and storage before and after opening before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose one small product first and say you will read that product's ingredients and unopened and opened storage conditions before deciding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品名はこちらで、原材料と保存の欄は裏側です。大きい品と同じ条件と決めず、ご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is its name; ingredients and storage are on the back. Read them without assuming the conditions are the same as the large product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この小さい一本の表示を確認します。今日飲む分だけを選び、開けた大瓶を机で何日も保存する予定にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小さい一本の表示を確かめ、今日飲む分を選んで開封大瓶を机で数日保管しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check this small bottle's label. I will choose only today's drink and will not plan to keep an opened large bottle on my desk for days.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the small bottle's label, choose today's amount and say you will not store the opened large bottle on the desk for several days. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。大きい方はこちらにお戻しいただけます。表示でまだ分かりにくい所があれば、お会計前にお声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. You can return the large one here. If any label detail is still unclear, ask before checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図を見比べていらっしゃいますね。どの場所を探していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are comparing the map. Which place are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 休憩所まで散歩して、この入口へ戻りたいです。でも、目の前の花壇と図の位置が合わず、どちらへ歩くか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 休憩所へ歩いて同じ入口へ戻りたいが、現地の花壇と図の位置が合わず方向が不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to walk to the rest area and return to this entrance. But the flowerbed in front of me does not match its map position, so I do not know which way to walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want the rest area and the same entrance back, but cannot identify direction because the visible flowerbed does not match the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、今いる案内所の印を見ましょう。図をこちらの向きに回すと、目の前に見える花壇と合わせて考えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First look at the marker for this information office. Rotate the map this way and you can relate it to the flowerbed in front of you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙を逆向きに持っていたのですね。回すと、今いる案内所と目の前の花壇の並びが分かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙を逆に持っていたと気づき、回して案内所と花壇の位置関係が分かったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was holding the paper the opposite way. Turning it makes the relationship between this office and the flowerbed clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Realize the paper was reversed and say rotating it clarified the office and flowerbed positions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 向きがそろったら、入口と休憩所の印も見てみましょう。どちらの入口からお入りになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: With orientation aligned, check the entrance and rest-area markers too. Which entrance did you come through?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの花壇に近い入口から来ました。もう一つの入口と区別して、戻る方に丸を付けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 花壇に近い入口から入り、別の入口と混同しないよう戻る方に丸を付けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: This one near the flowerbed. I want to circle the entrance to return to, distinguishing it from the other entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you entered near the flowerbed and want to circle the return entrance to avoid confusing it with the other one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、その入口を戻る目印にしてください。休憩所は図のこの印です。現在地と二つの目印の関係を確かめられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Use that entrance as your return landmark. The rest area is this symbol. Can you confirm the relationship of your current position and the two landmarks?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内所、休憩所、丸を付けた入口の順に指して確認します。図の上だけで左右を決めず、見える物と照らし合わせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内所・休憩所・戻る入口を指して確認し、紙の左右だけでなく見える物と照合したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will point in order to the office, rest area and circled entrance. I want to compare visible things rather than decide left and right only on paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point to office, rest area and return entrance, and ask to match visible landmarks rather than paper left and right alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように、立っている場所と表示を合わせてご覧ください。歩きながら紙だけを追わず、分からなくなったら立ち止まって確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, match your standing position with the display that way. Do not follow only the paper while walking; stop and check if unsure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まずここで向きを確かめてから歩きます。戻る時も丸の入口を探し、見える目印と合わなければその場で案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出発前に向きを確かめ、戻る時も印の入口と現地が合わなければ立ち止まって確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check orientation here before walking. Coming back, I will look for the circled entrance and stop to check guidance if visible landmarks do not match.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check orientation before departure and say you will stop to check on return if the marked entrance and surroundings do not match. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 図の向きと戻る目印を確認できましたね。園内の表示も見ながら、ご自分のペースでお楽しみください。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have checked map orientation and the return landmark. Enjoy the park at your own pace, watching the signs too. Have a good walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベビーカーでの移動ですね。これから乗る列車がお決まりでしたら、案内を一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Travelling with a stroller, then. If you know your train, let us check the guidance together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この列車に乗ります。改札に入ってすぐのエレベーターなら、そのホームへ行けると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗る列車を示し、改札直後のエレベーターで目的ホームへ行けると思っていたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am taking this train. I thought the elevator just after the ticket gates would reach that platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the train and say you thought the elevator immediately after the gates reached your intended platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 手前のものは反対側のホームへつながっています。この列車の表示と、目的のホームを先に照らし合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The nearer one leads to the opposite platform. First match this train's display with the intended platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 近いだけで選ぶと別のホームへ行ってしまうのですね。ベビーカーを畳んで階段で運ぶより、目的のホームまで段差を避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 近い設備だと別ホームになると理解し、ベビーカーを階段で運ばず段差を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Choosing just the nearest would take me to another platform. I want to avoid steps all the way there rather than fold the stroller and carry it upstairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the nearest facility reaches another platform and request a step-free route without carrying the stroller on stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この図では、奥の通路から向かうエレベーターが該当します。設備の案内表示も現地で確かめてください。列車までの時間に余裕はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this diagram, the elevator approached through the farther passage is the relevant one. Check the equipment signs on site too. Do you have time before the train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ぎりぎりかもしれません。急いで階段へ変えることはせず、案内された経路で行けるか、先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 時間がぎりぎりでも階段へ変更して急がず、案内経路で行けるか先に確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It may be very tight. I will not switch to stairs and rush; I want to check first whether I can use the advised route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Even with little time, do not rush by changing to stairs; request confirmation of the advised route first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 到着を急がず、必要なら係員にお声がけください。列車に間に合うとはお約束できません。奥へ進む前に通路の分かれ目を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not rush to arrive, and ask staff if needed. We cannot promise you will catch the train. Before going farther, check the passage fork.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 売店の手前で曲がると思っていましたが、図では売店を過ぎた所ですね。その分かれ目を丸で囲んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 売店の手前ではなく過ぎた所の分岐だと図で読み直し、曲がる地点へ丸印を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I thought I turned before the shop, but the diagram shows after it. Could you circle that fork?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reread the diagram as a fork after rather than before the shop and request a circle at the turn. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かれ目と、その先のエレベーターを記しました。途中で表示が違うと思ったら、進む前に近くの係員へこの図をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I marked the fork and elevator beyond. If signs seem different along the way, show this diagram to nearby staff before continuing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 丸の所で現地の表示と照合します。間に合わせようと別の階段へ行かず、わからなくなったら図を見せて尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 丸印と現地表示を照合し、間に合わせるため別の階段へ行かず不明なら図を見せて尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will compare the circled point with the actual signs. I will not take different stairs to catch the train; if unsure, I will show the diagram and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the circle and actual signs, and say you will ask with the diagram if unsure rather than use other stairs to make the train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが印を付けた図です。列車の行き先とホームも改めてご確認ください。ベビーカーと周囲に気を配り、どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the marked diagram. Check the train's destination and platform again too. Mind the stroller and surroundings, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後の手続きについてですね。これまでに、どこへ何を提出されたか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: About procedures after moving. Tell me where you have submitted what so far.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社へ新しい住所の用紙を出しました。それで役所への連絡も済んだのかと思いましたが、確信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社へ新住所の用紙を出し、役所への連絡も済んだかは不確かだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I submitted a new-address form to work. I thought that might also finish notifying the municipal office, but I am unsure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain submitting a new-address form to work and uncertainty about whether the municipal office was notified too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社に出した用紙と、こちらで行う手続きが同じとは限りません。会社から、こちらの受付を終えたという控えは受け取りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The work form is not necessarily the same as the procedure here. Did work give you a receipt showing acceptance here was completed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 控えはありません。会社の住所連絡票に署名しただけなので、役所の手続きも済んだとは言わずに相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 役所受付の控えはなく会社連絡票へ署名しただけなので、行政手続き完了と断言せず相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: No receipt. I only signed work's address notification form, so I will ask without claiming the municipal procedure is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have no municipal receipt and only signed work's notification, so you will inquire without asserting administrative completion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その状況を担当へ伝えましょう。以前のお住まいは別の市区町村でしたか。転居に関してお持ちの書類も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell staff that situation. Was your previous home in another municipality? Also tell us what moving documents you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 以前は別の市でした。前の窓口で受け取った封筒は家に置いてきて、今日は在留カードしか持っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 以前は別の市に住み、前の窓口の封筒は自宅で今日は在留カードだけだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was another city. I left the envelope from the previous counter at home and only have my residence card today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain previously living in another city, leaving the previous counter's envelope at home, and having only a residence card today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類がそろっているかは担当確認が必要です。今日は状況を説明し、何を追加で持って来るかを確かめる相談としてご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff must confirm whether documents are sufficient. Today we can guide you to explain the situation and ask what else to bring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その相談をお願いします。家へ取りに戻る前に、封筒の中身を確認する必要があるか、担当の方へ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不足確認の相談を希望し、取りに帰る前に自宅封筒の中身を確認する必要があるか担当へ聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please arrange that inquiry. Before going home for it, I want to ask staff whether I need to check the envelope's contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request the missing-document inquiry and ask staff whether the home envelope's contents need checking before going back for it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会社へ出した物と、自宅にある書類を別々にメモすると伝わりやすいです。会社が何か代わりにしたかについても、会社に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Separate notes of what you submitted to work and what documents are at home will help. Ask work whether it did anything on your behalf too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社には住所連絡票だけ、自宅には前の窓口の封筒、と分けて書きました。必要な物の説明を受けてから持参し直し、会社にも対応範囲を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社提出物と自宅書類を分けてメモし、必要物を聞いて再持参し会社にも対応範囲を尋ねると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I wrote separately: only an address form to work, and the previous counter's envelope at home. I will return with documents after hearing what is needed, and ask work the scope of what it handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note work submissions and home documents separately, decide to bring required items after guidance, and ask work what it handled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況のメモができましたね。こちらの担当席へどうぞ。今日は手続き完了とはせず、持参物と次の進め方を確認する相談として引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have your situation noted. Please go to this staff desk. We will hand over an inquiry about documents and next steps, not completion today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約票をお持ちですね。日時のことで確認したいのは、どのような点ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have an appointment slip. What would you like to check about the date or time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 九時受付とあります。十時には職場へ戻りたいのですが、九時からすぐ診察を受けられるという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 九時受付がすぐ診察を受けられる意味なのか尋ね、十時に職場へ戻りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says reception at nine. I want to return to work by ten; does it mean I can see the doctor immediately from nine?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether nine o'clock reception means immediate consultation and say you want to return to work by ten. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付の時刻であって、診察開始や終了をお約束する時刻ではありません。その後の予定に間に合うとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is reception time, not a promised start or finish of consultation. We cannot say you will make your later commitment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一時間あれば終わると考えていました。時間を区切って急ぐより、午後に変更できるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一時間で終わると思っていたと認め、急がず済む午後へ予約変更を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought an hour would be enough. Rather than rush within a fixed time, I want advice on moving the appointment to afternoon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge expecting completion in an hour and request moving to afternoon to avoid rushing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 午後のご希望を担当へ照会します。変更について確認するため、この予約票とご本人の情報を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask staff about afternoon availability. May I see your slip and personal information to check the change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。別の日でも午後なら仕事を休めますが、検査の予定が付いているかは自分ではわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約票と本人情報を示し、別日でも午後なら休めるが検査予定は不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here. I can take time off in an afternoon on another day too, but I do not know whether tests are attached to this booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your slip and information, say another afternoon is possible, but attached tests are unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 検査などの予定も担当へ確認してもらいます。変更前に受けている説明や、気になる症状の変化があればお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff will check tests and other arrangements too. Tell us any instructions you received or symptom changes of concern before changing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 症状の変化はありません。もらった説明の紙は家にあるので、予約を動かす前に、その内容も伝える必要があるか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 症状変化はないが説明書が自宅にあり、予約変更前にその内容も伝える必要があるか確かめたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: No symptom change. The instruction sheet is at home, and I want to check whether its contents must be relayed before moving the appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say symptoms have not changed but instructions are at home, and ask whether their contents must be conveyed before rescheduling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その紙があることを担当へ伝えましょう。現時点では変更は終わっていません。希望と確認事項を、このメモで見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell staff that paper exists. The change is not complete yet. Review the wishes and checks on this note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 午後希望、検査予定の確認、家の説明書の扱いですね。九時受付だけで十時に戻れるとは考えず、変更可否の返事を聞いてから職場へ予定を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 午後希望・検査・説明書の三点を確認し、十時帰職を決めつけず変更返答後に職場へ予定を知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Afternoon preference, test schedule, and handling the instructions at home. I will not assume nine reception lets me return by ten; I will tell work my plans after the rescheduling answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm afternoon, tests and instructions, avoid assuming return to work by ten, and notify work after the change response. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 三点を担当に引き継ぎました。受付時刻と診察の終了見込みは別として、返答の内容をお確かめください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have passed on the three points. Check the reply while distinguishing reception time from expected consultation completion. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見つからないとのことですね。ご自身の自転車でしょうか、それとも借りた物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your bicycle cannot be found. Is it yours or borrowed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 兄から借りた自転車です。店の前に停めたつもりなのですが、買い物の後に見つかりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の物でなく兄から借りた自転車が店前で見つからないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is borrowed from my older brother. I thought I parked outside the shop, but could not find it after shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the bicycle missing outside the shop is borrowed from your older brother, not your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 借りた物なのですね。停めた時刻と車体の特徴を教えてください。お兄様にも、すでに連絡されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Borrowed, then. Tell us parking time and bicycle features. Have you contacted your brother yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼の十二時ごろ停めました。紺色で後ろに銀色のかごがあります。兄へはメッセージを送りましたが、まだ返事がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十二時ごろ駐輪し紺色で後ろに銀色のかごがあること、兄へ送信済みだが未返信と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around twelve noon. Dark blue with a silver basket at the rear. I messaged my brother but he has not replied.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain parking around noon, dark-blue color and silver rear basket, and sending your brother a message without a reply yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: わかりました。登録番号などがわかる資料はお手元にありますか。お兄様が持っている場合は、その点も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Do you have material showing a registration number? Tell us too if your brother has it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号の控えは兄が持っています。この写真はありますが、前に乗っていた別の自転車も写っているので、どちらか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 登録控えは兄にあり、写真には以前の別車体もあるので取り違えを確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My brother has the number record. I have photos, but they include another bicycle he used before, so I want to check which is which.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your brother has the registration record and you want to avoid mixing up photos that also include his previous bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 違う車体の情報を混ぜないよう、色やかごが合う写真を分けましょう。お兄様から連絡が来たら、今の状況も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Separate the photo matching color and basket to avoid mixing information from different bicycles. When your brother responds, check the current situation too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この右側の写真が借りた物です。今、兄から「今日は自転車を使っている」と返事が来ましたが、同じ物かまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 借りたのは右写真と示し、兄が使っていると返信したが同一車体かはまだ確認していないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The photo on the right is the borrowed one. My brother just replied, 'I am using the bicycle today,' but I have not asked whether it is the same one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point to the right photo as the borrowed bicycle and say your brother reports using a bike, but the same bicycle is not confirmed yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、その紺色で後ろにかごのある自転車なのか、確認してみてください。同じ物だとわかるまでは、見つかったとは決めないでおきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ask whether it is that dark-blue bicycle with a rear basket. Let us not decide it has been found until it is confirmed as the same one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 兄が同じ写真を見て、その紺色の物を店の前から持ち帰り、今使っていると返しました。兄の手元にあると確認できたので、見当たらないという先ほどの説明を訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 兄が写真の紺色車体を店前から持ち帰って使っていると確認し、所在不明という先ほどの申告を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: My brother saw the same photo and replied that he took that dark-blue one home from outside the shop and is using it now. I have confirmed it is with him, so I correct my earlier statement that its whereabouts were unknown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your brother took the photographed dark-blue bicycle from outside the shop and is using it, and correct the earlier missing-bike report. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お兄様がその車体を使っているとの確認が取れた、と記録を更新しました。本日のご相談はこの内容で区切ります。借りた物の所在がわかってよかったですね。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I updated the record that your brother's use of that bicycle is confirmed. We will close today's inquiry on that basis. Good that you located the borrowed bicycle. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類を送る封筒のほかに、もう一枚封筒がありますね。こちらは何にお使いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Besides the envelope for sending documents, you have another envelope. What is this one for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 提出先から書類を返してもらうため、同封する封筒です。送るときに追跡を付ければ、戻るときも同じ番号で見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同封する返信用封筒を示し、往路に追跡を付ければ返送も同番号で見られるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is enclosed so the recipient can send documents back. If I track the outgoing mail, can I track the return with the same number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the enclosed return envelope and ask whether tracking the outward mailing also tracks the return with the same number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 送る郵便と返ってくる郵便は別に考えましょう。往路の番号だけで返送まで確認できると決めないでください。返信方法の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Treat outgoing and returning mail separately. Do not assume the outward number tracks the return too. Is a return method specified?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内は返信用封筒を同封とだけあります。返送にも記録を残したいのですが、私が方法を決めてよいのかはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内は返信用封筒同封のみで、自分で記録付きの返信方法を選べるか未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The guidance only says enclose a return envelope. I want a record for return too, but have not asked whether I may choose that method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say guidance only requires a return envelope and you have not confirmed authority to choose a recorded return method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出先が対応できる方法を先に確認しましょう。返信用の封筒に、ご自身の宛先は書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: First check what method the recipient can handle. Have you written your own address on the return envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 宛先は書きました。ただ、返ってくる書類の枚数がわからないので、今用意した小さい封筒で足りるかも不明です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自宅宛先は書いたが返送枚数不明のため小型封筒で足りるかも不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. But I do not know the number of returning sheets, so I also do not know whether this small envelope is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your home address is written but the return sheet count and suitability of the small envelope are unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大きさや必要な料金も、返送物によって確認が要ります。返信方法と一緒に、枚数や折り曲げてよいかも尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Size and required postage also depend on the returning contents. Ask about the number of sheets and whether folding is allowed, along with the method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 折らずに返してもらう必要があるかも聞きます。まだ外側の封筒は閉じず、返信用の準備ができてから差し出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 折らずに返す必要も提出先に聞き、返信準備ができるまで外封筒を閉じず差出しを待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask whether they must be returned unfolded too. I will not seal the outer envelope yet and will wait to send until return preparations are ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the recipient whether an unfolded return is required, and wait to seal and send the outer envelope until return preparations are ready. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順番なら、確認した返信条件を同封前に見直せます。往路の記録と返信用の記録も、ご自身で区別して保管しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: That order lets you review confirmed return conditions before enclosing it. Keep outward and return records separately yourself too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 往路と返信を別の欄にしてメモします。今日は封筒を持ち帰り、提出先に方法と返送物を確認してから、料金も相談し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 往路と返信を分けて記録し、今日は持ち帰り提出先の条件を聞いてから料金も再相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will make separate outward and return sections in my notes. Today I will take the envelopes home, check the method and returning contents with the recipient, then ask about postage again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record outward and return separately, take envelopes home today, ask the recipient's conditions, then consult again about postage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二枚ともお返しします。返送の条件がわかりましたら、その案内も一緒にお持ちください。ご相談いただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-45208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are both envelopes back. Once return conditions are known, bring those instructions too. Thank you for asking.
